text:
Maya: FYI customer (ACME) just reported rerank calls started failing overnight. They say nothing changed on their side except a deploy that kept using an internal model id. Example request + error below, sending them to us to unblock asap.

Maya: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-2023-v2","queries":["show me top answers"],"documents":[["doc1","doc2"]]}'

Maya: Response:
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{"error":"model not found","code":"model_not_found","model_id":"rerank-2023-v2"}

Kevin: Do we have the request_id or backend request logs? Can you paste X-Request-Id from their header or the timestamp so I can grep the gateway logs.

Maya: Request header had X-Request-Id: req_01F8Y2Z8. Grepped prod logs, found these lines (trimmed):
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] tenant=acme req=req_01F8Y2Z8 route=/v1/rerank model_lookup=model_alias_lookup
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] tenant=acme alias=acme-ranker -> repointed to rerank-stable-2025 at 2026-03-16T22:01:02Z
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] model_lookup: requested explicit model id rerank-2023-v2 not found in registry
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] response: 404 model_not_found

Maya: Customer confirms they store literal model ids in their DB (they pinned rerank-2023-v2). They expected redirects to keep working.

Sanjay: TL;DR: rerank-2023-v2 was retired last night as part of model churn. If a model is deleted from the registry we return model_not_found (404). We usually add a deprecation period where a 410/deprecated code is returned, but this model skipped the soft-deprecation window because of a cleanup job. We also have alias repoints that work if the customer calls the tenant alias, not the internal model id.

Sanjay: Immediate mitigation options:
- Short term: we can create a temporary alias mapping rerank-2023-v2 -> rerank-stable-2025 for tenant=acme (fast, internal console change)
- Medium: ask customer to switch to protected tenant alias (acme-ranker) which will remain stable across repoints
- Longer: we should add a guard to make model deletions emit a 410 with a recommended replacement field so clients can auto-rewrite.

Maya: Customer wants a stopgap mapping now. Can eng-ml create the alias redirect? They are on a paid Dedicated plan and this is high priority.

eng-ml-oncall: @Maya I can add the redirect. Quick question: do you want it tenant-scoped or global? Tenant-scoped is safer.

Maya: Tenant-scoped please. acme only.

Kevin: Also check client-side caches. Many SDKs cache resolved model ids for 24h. If we add mapping but their local cache contains a mapping to a deleted id, they may keep erroring until they refresh.

Maya: Noted. I'll send the customer instructions to clear their SDK cache (restart app or call /v1/resolve?force=true). Will update after they confirm.

Sanjay: Repro steps for internal QA (do not share externally):
1) delete model rerank-2023-v2 from registry
2) call rerank with explicit model id -> observe 404
3) create tenant-scoped alias mapping rerank-2023-v2 -> rerank-stable-2025 -> call rerank with same explicit model id -> should be resolved at routing layer

Sanjay: Internal CLI to inspect mappings: rgctl alias list --tenant acme

support-bot: Ticket created CS-4821, priority=urgent, owner=maya. Escalation routed to eng-ml-oncall.

eng-ml-oncall: Done — created tenant-scoped redirect for acme linking rerank-2023-v2 -> rerank-stable-2025. Please verify.

Maya: Verified with customer, requests now return 200 and expected scores. Customer asked for root cause and asks we prevent silent deletion in future.

Kevin: Follow-ups for engineering:
- Add a small safety window to prevent immediate deletion if a model id is still referenced by any tenant mapping or active alias
- Emit a clear deprecation payload (HTTP 410 + replacement) when we retire models
- Add a dashboard alert when cleanup job deletes models with >0 tenant references

Sanjay: I'll open an RFC and a bug for the cleanup job. Also proposing an API improvement: when a client supplies an explicit model id, include a diagnostics header X-Model-Status: retired|active|alias-redirect and X-Model-Replacement when applicable.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll close CS-4821 after customer confirms no further failures. Will follow up on the RFC PR when ready. :thumbsup:
